role: C04 small Material individual contextual source review
decision: The upstream M2 paginator token switches disabled icon color from foreground base at 12% to system on-surface at 38%. The owned exported paginator-color route calls its companion M2 token map, which retains foreground base at 12%, as in the Material 16 token map; its separate exported legacy-paginator-color route and legacy component theme retain the historical foreground disabled key for disabled navigation borders. Preserve both historical routes rather than transplanting the later system-color rewrite. Custom-palette and light/dark rendered CSS, including mixed modern and legacy use, remain open; this source decision does not establish rendered equivalence.
